records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.context: Sojin challenges Maria at sea. Yukihisa tells him to stop. Sojin calls him a disgrace for siding with foreigners, and Yukihisa challenges his attacks on the mainland coast. Sojin jeers at him and offers to spare only Maria if she surrenders and becomes his. Maria mocks his beard, and he answers with a threat.
records.Japanese:
FIのあねさんよ！
今日こそは決着をつけさせてもらうぜ！
records.previous_English: Well, FI! Today we're settling this once and for all!
records.source_meaning: Sojin calls to the captain with rough familiarity and declares that today he will settle the score.
records.localization_note: Keep the personalized address and the decisive challenge. Put the rest of the threat after the salute so a long captain name cannot force “settling” onto a line by itself.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.context: Sojin challenges Maria at sea. Yukihisa tells him to stop. Sojin calls him a disgrace for siding with foreigners, and Yukihisa challenges his attacks on the mainland coast. Sojin jeers at him and offers to spare only Maria if she surrenders and becomes his. Maria mocks his beard, and he answers with a threat.
records.Japanese:
クルシマ！
愚かな所行はやめよ！
records.source_meaning: Yukihisa tells Kurushima to stop his foolish conduct.
records.localization_note: “End this folly” fits Yukihisa’s formal, direct rebuke and the short pause before Sojin lashes back.

records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.context: Sojin challenges Maria at sea. Yukihisa tells him to stop. Sojin calls him a disgrace for siding with foreigners, and Yukihisa challenges his attacks on the mainland coast. 異国人の肩ぁ持ちやがって！

records.previous_English: A samurai siding with foreigners! You shame every warrior!
records.source_meaning: Sojin sneers that Yukihisa sides with foreigners despite being a samurai, and calls him unworthy of the name.
records.localization_note: Aim the disgrace at Yukihisa himself and keep the accusation about taking the foreigners’ side.

records.context: Sojin challenges Maria at sea. Yukihisa tells him to stop. Sojin calls him a disgrace for siding with foreigners, and Yukihisa challenges his attacks on the mainland coast. records.Japanese:
へっへっへ、FIよ！
俺の女になるなら、おとなしく降参
してもいいぞ！

records.previous_English: Heh heh, FI! Be my woman and surrender. Your life alone will be spared!
records.source_meaning: Sojin laughs, addresses the captain, and makes a coercive offer. If she surrenders quietly and becomes his, he will spare her alone.
records.localization_note: Keep both conditions and put the promise in Sojin’s own voice. “Only you” keeps the threat to everyone else implicit.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.context: Sojin challenges Maria at sea. Yukihisa tells him to stop. Sojin calls him a disgrace for siding with foreigners, and Yukihisa challenges his attacks on the mainland coast. records.Japanese:
ソウジン・クルシマ…
それ以上無駄口を叩くようなら、その
威気高な髭をむしり取ってあげるわ
records.previous_English: Sojin Kurushima... Keep running your mouth, and I'll pluck out that arrogant beard of yours.
records.source_meaning: Maria tells Sojin that if he keeps talking nonsense she will pluck out his haughty-looking beard.
records.localization_note: “Mouth off” matches the provocation. “High-and-mighty beard” preserves the joke while Maria answers his threat with one of her own.
